portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating
system. 

Bug fixes:

* iscsi target deadlocks when the same host acts as an initiator to itself (i.e. connects via 127.0.0.1) (BZ#2182096)

* CNB: Update TC subsystem to upstream v5.18 (BZ#2179433)

* Backport kernel audit enhancements and fixes from v5.13-rc1 to v5.16-rc6 (BZ#2180419)

* RHEL 8.7: please integrate "powerpc/64/kdump: Limit kdump base to 512MB" patch. (BZ#2154273)

* RHEL8.4 - s390/smp,vdso: fix ASCE handling (BZ#2176465)

* Node locked up and not responsive due to potential rcu stall (BZ#2178274)

* RHEL8: blktests block/001 hang during the test (BZ#2178237)

* Client not able to connect to rhel server: SYN is answered by chalange ACK and RST is ignored (BZ#2182654)
